note: OSV lists no fix commit; the fix is b831454889 in 4.1.135 ("Treat clients MAX_HEADER_LIST_SIZE as advisory"). A server applied the client's SETTINGS_MAX_HEADER_LIST_SIZE to its own responses in DefaultHttp2ConnectionEncoder.remoteSettings, so a small value made every response fail and reset the stream. Present in 4.1.42, 4.1.100, 4.1.131 and 4.2.6, and under the io.grpc.netty.shaded prefix in grpc-netty-shaded 1.50.0 and 1.70.0. Any HTTP/2 server built on Netty reaches it.
